snippet.title: Bakery Story 2
snippet.description:
Decorate and design the bakery of your dreams in Bakery Story 2! Bake sweet treats to keep your customers happy- From the creators who brought you Bakery Story, it’s a fun & tasty new baking adventure!

Download: 
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/bakery-story-2/id1012151919?mt=8&at=10l3QL&ct=youtube
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storm8studios.bakerytwo&hl=en

Create desserts, collect special ingredients, decorate, and share in a beautiful 3D world. Stunning looks and great music await in your personalized bakery!

BAKERY STORY 2 FEATURES:

BAKING GAME
- Bakery shops come to life, presented in colorful, detailed 3D
- Chef games with vibrant graphics will make you feel the heat of the kitchen as you bake up sweet treats!
- Sweet bakery treats and savory 3D graphics will make your tummy rumble

DESGIN YOUR BAKERY
- Design games let you build a bakery shop with custom furniture, wallpaper, art and more
- Bakery stories are unique to each player. Build giant donut tables, decorate with cake displays and potted plants, and add paintings or wallpapers for color
- Create a perfect pastry paradise using thousands of bakery customization options

DECORATING GAMES
- Decorate with thousands of tables, wallpapers, art pieces and more
- Virtual worlds come to life as you build and run the bakery shop of your dreams!
- Sweet bakery decorations include tons of unique art, furniture, tables and more

RECIPES
- Recipes offer sweet treats your customers will love
- Chef games challenge you to customize your menu with your favorite recipes to make your bakery feel like home
- Bake and decorate dozens of mouth-watering desserts! From peach cobbler to alfajores, sweet potato pie to the fabled cronut, Bakery Story 2 has your favorite treats

TIME MANAGEMENT GAMES
- Diner games and simulations mix as you bake sweet treats to keep your bakery alive!
- Your bakery runs on creating delicious desserts and making customers happy

GAMES WITH FRIENDS
- Online game features include chatting, trading and secret sharing with your baker friends
- Cake and cookie recipes for everyone! Share your sweet recipes and tips with friends and watch your fortunes soar

COOKING GAMES FOR FREE
- FREE to download, and FREE to play. Look forward to FREE updates including new recipes, treats, decorations and more!

Tell your bakery stories the way only you can. Catch cake mania as you bake sweet recipes, design incredible interiors, and share your bakery town in games with friends! Decorate with thousands of items and explore friends’ games to find even more sugary secrets.

Restaurant games fans will love sharing their bakery story in casual games of this bake shop simulation!

Download Bakery Story 2 today – it’s one sweet baking game!

Storm8 Studios is the #1 Mobile Social Game Developer on Android.
